overview.title: Decades of Specialized CNG System Integration
overview.lead: Since 1998, Car's Energy Co. has operated at the forefront of clean automotive propulsion in North India.
overview.p1: As an authorized retrofitting center (RFC Code No. 261), we do not treat alternative fuel conversion as a generic mechanical swap. Every vehicle model possesses unique manifold geometries, ignition profiles, and intake parameters. Our workshop integrates calibrated sequential gas injection systems with precision ECU remapping, ensuring optimal engine response, zero check-engine warnings, and strict emission compliance.
overview.p2: From wholesale distribution of genuine Italian and Indian conversion kits to multi-point cylinder hydrostatic pressure certifications and RTO registration endorsements, we handle the entire vehicle lifecycle with engineering rigor.

howItWorks.title: Structured 4-Stage Conversion Process
howItWorks.description: Every vehicle undergoes a disciplined, step-by-step engineering cycle from first inspection to legal registration.

steps.title: Pre-Fitment Assessment
steps.description: Diagnostic scan of ignition health, compression ratios, and electrical harness compatibility with the chosen kit.

steps.title: Precision Hardware Fitment
steps.description: Installation of high-pressure seamless cylinders, calibrated reducers, multi-point rail injectors, and rigid gas piping.

steps.title: Digital ECU Calibration
steps.description: Software-driven fuel mapping and road-load testing to calibrate air-fuel ratios seamlessly across RPM bands.

steps.title: Safety Audit & Handover
steps.description: Electronic sniff-testing for micro-leaks, compliance certificate issue, and guidance through final RTO RC endorsement.
